name: Codeshot
soft_passes: #3 silhouette is internal tonal modelling, not cutout — camera not nameable from solid-black outer shape
#4 16px squint: charcoal-on-charcoal lens smears to a blob, traffic-light triad is sole small-size anchor; lens legible only >=32px
#7 figure-ground: lens barrel #37 vs body #2F-#36 is sub-3:1, tone-on-tone; only the triad clears 3:1
failures: #10 variant robustness: fixed dark raster with a BAKED drop shadow, not layered Icon Composer artwork; identity depends on dark body carrying the triad and collapses under tinted/clear modes

palette.accent: #FF6460 / #FFC31F / #00E71A (traffic-light triad — brighter/candier than macOS system swatches)

light_model: single soft top-down: top-left speculars on the glossy spheres, grey reflection on upper lens glass, body ramp light-top->dark-bottom, short baked micro-shadows; environmental specular depicts a physical lens, not system glass
layer_stack: baked squircle body (charcoal ramp) + baked drop shadow
recessed titlebar band with horizontal seam
three glossy traffic-light spheres in sockets (red/yellow/green)
glass element with grey specular oval #6B6B6B
devices: camera-lens-as-window dual metaphor (a snapshot of a code window)
macOS traffic-light triad as the sole brand accent moment
titlebar seam bisecting the body into chrome + camera
tone-on-tone charcoal modelling of the subject
rhymes_hint: nocturnal skeuomorphic object icons — charcoal/dark-neutral Big-Sur squircle with a photoreal object (lens/device) and a single saturated micro-accent; capture/screenshot-tool family and macOS-chrome-quotation (framed-window) icons
notes: 1024 master, transparent bg (alpha 0), opaque bbox x100-922/y100-932 with soft baked-shadow falloff y915-940 — pre-masked squircle, NOT full-bleed square. Big-Sur era, not Liquid Glass: no translucency/refraction/layer variants; the lens specular is physical, not system glass. Traffic-light hues deviate from macOS system swatches (system red #FF383C, yellow #FFCC00, green #34C759). Subject-mining is honest: the app outputs dark code cards with window chrome, so the icon quotes its own artifact rather than the cover's vibrant marketing gradient. Key learning for synthesis: an all-neutral tone-on-tone subject offloads ALL small-size legibility onto a saturated micro-accent — works at Dock size, fails the 16px menu-bar test for the primary subject.
